doctrine: Adapt only the Gentle AI mechanisms that strengthen Overgo's existing owners. RepoDB content identities, lineage, compare-and-set commits, recipe decisions, experiment lifecycles, and shared operation status remain authoritative. New contracts must compose with those owners, carry exact artifact and command identities, remain independent of model family, tensor shape, dataset distribution, backend topology, worker population, and user interface, and fail closed on stale, ambiguous, or incomplete evidence.

items.title: Make blocked operations recoverable through typed interface-neutral actions

steps.title: Add exact argv recovery and consent envelopes to shared operation status
steps.rationale: Training, evaluation, serving, CLI, and GUI callers need the same machine-readable reason, evidence, and runnable continuation instead of parsing prose or inventing interface-specific recovery instructions.

items.title: Use filesystem identity for model and dataset locations

steps.title: Canonicalize and compare local RepoDB locations by filesystem identity
steps.rationale: Different path spellings, links, case behavior, and nonexistent descendants must not create conflicting identities or let model and dataset roots escape their declared authority.

items.title: Verify that blocked lifecycle paths have real recoveries

steps.title: Add reusable journey checks for blocked training, evaluation, and serving operations
steps.rationale: A refusal is operationally complete only when its advertised action is registered, bounded, interface-neutral, and demonstrably reaches a non-dead-end state for the same immutable subject.
